name: Matched noisy-positive continuation at both original rates 3000 to 30000
label: DEVELOPMENT; no TEST
hypothesis: The 3000-update mismatch screen may miss late memorization or a delayed task benefit. At fixed 30000 updates, do bounded VCS objectives reduce clean-DEV degradation relative to matched BCE/NCE under a changed P and unchanged empirical marginals?
theory: Original paper unchanged. Same normalized cosine function class and original four objectives. Corruption changes positive empirical P while preserving each within-scene empirical marginal and exact product Q.

recipe.continuation: All encoders, AdamW moments/counters, sampler and local/global RNG from each ORIGINAL noisy fixed step3000; never use the CAL-selected checkpoint. Inherited noise rate continues unchanged.
recipe.cal: COS curves only; no early stopping or checkpoint selection.
recipe.dev: Fixed3000 and30000 COS, samejob sameGPU fullDEV10perturbations/core; no bestDEV selection.
recipe.limitation: Long-short changes duration and preset LR decay; not pure duration effect. Inherited prefix may use different GPU, disclosed.

report.primary: Fixed30000 exact minus BCE/NCE scene/core-macro strict<9 and loose<42, allseeds; exact−perm andlong−short.
report.practical_signal: For each dataset/rate exact beats BOTH BCE and NCE by >=1pp strict with >=2/3 positive seeds and loose loss <=.25pp. Report failure too; neither early stopping nor a permanent prohibition. Both rates fully run.

execution.gate: CPU48 real source-state restores, 3000-step input/noise agreement, first5 future draws equal clean stream, 8 synthetic full-state replay checks, bijection and corruption checks; BF+EPFL gates cover ALL4 arms at BOTH rates with real FIT3steps/roundtrip/CALgradient. No outcome gate.
execution.retry: No automatic retry; stop only for technical nonfinite values, corrupt identities/inputs, prohibited access, resource/time limit. Preserve every attempt.

noise.mechanism: Reuse original stateless per-scene cyclic-subset corruption. Same exact assignment across arms, same crop/draw stream across noise levels and clean continuation. Changing rate changes P; finite sample marginal-product Q unchanged. No theoretical guarantee of robust task performance is asserted.

comparisons.primary: For each dataset and rate separately, exact minus BOTH BCE and NCE at fixed30000 COS DEV; report both rates, all seeds.
secondary: Difference-in-differences versus already-frozen clean-long24 at fixed30000, conditional on complete verified clean series; cross-hardware prefix caveat
comparisons.interpretation: Controlled synthetic correspondence noise, not independent real-noise evidence. No selecting rate, checkpoint, readout or loss from DEV.

preexisting_evidence: Original48 noisy3000 experiments already complete without consistent exact advantage; clean-long24 active. New48 approved by user long-validation instruction, not contingent on partial clean-long outcomes.
_publication_note: Public scientific protocol excerpt; not an operational freeze, source manifest or admission authorization.
